description: Two individually well-supported claims from unrelated literatures are linked by a plausible-sounding but unsupported synthesis. This is the dominant residual failure mode in long-form generated articles - a red herring, not a hallucination.

claim_a.claim_text: Material X exhibits a phase transition at 340K.

claim_b.claim_text: Cognitive performance declines above 30C ambient temperature.

input.proposed_synthesis: Material X's transition temperature therefore makes it suitable for cognitive-performance-preserving building materials.

findings.reason: The synthesis link is asserted, not evidenced. No source connects the material's transition temperature to ambient conditions in occupied space, nor to cognitive outcomes. Both endpoints are supported; the edge between them is not.

pass_condition: The synthesis edge is assigned low relation confidence and raises an over_association finding. Accepting the synthesis because both endpoints are well cited is a fixture failure.
